race.comment: MISHANI CROWN (6) is yet to strike through this campaign but is knocking on the door. Relishes this trip and her job's become easier with a few major scratchings. Drawn to get all the favours and keeps the claimer, who knows her well. Will give herself every chance. CRACKENTHORPE (12) was slowly away here fresh and was forced to race on a limb throughout but didn't lie down in a messy run home. Drawn much kinder this time and gets Marshall taking over. Shoulders strong peaks and a handy record on the home track. With even luck he will be there at the end. STREAK OF WINNING (7) dropped out quickly fresh at Doomben in and effort that was almost too mad to be true. Has been beaten a stretch in his last few but does boast a handy record on the home track. Willing to give one more chance. TONKATSU GODDESS (11) was much better second-up at Lismore and can improve again.
